name: Campingplatz Fohnsee
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Fohnsee is situated in Eben am Achensee directly on the lake shore, surrounded by dense forests and the dramatic peaks of the Karwendel mountains. The grounds offer well-kept pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, complete with modern sanitary amenities. Its peaceful, close-to-nature atmosphere makes it an ideal retreat for hikers, mountain bikers, and watersports lovers enjoying Lake Achensee and the nature reserve.
